topic: Series and parallel circuits and home electrical safety
key_concepts: Series circuits provide a single pathway for electric current
Parallel circuits provide multiple pathways for electric current
In series connections, current is the same throughout while voltage divides
In parallel connections, voltage is the same across branches while current divides
A break in a series circuit stops current flow in the entire circuit
A break in one branch of a parallel circuit allows other branches to continue working
Homes commonly use parallel connections for appliances
Series and parallel connections differ in bulb brightness and battery status
Circuit breakers, fuses, earthing, and double insulation are home electrical safety device
Electrical safety devices protect against hazards such as overcurrent and electric shock
